newsitem.title: USA: Zenith rises on Time Warner news.
newsitem.headline: Zenith rises on Time Warner news.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp's stock rose Tuesday on word that Time Warner Cable would use Zenith's set-top boxes to expand channel offerings and services in San Antonio, Texas, analysts said.
Zenith also said the Time Warner Inc subsidiary plans in the spring to bring real-time two-way capability to San Diego, Calif. cable subscribers using Zenith technology.
No terms were disclosed, but Kalb, Voorhis analyst Robert Gutenstein said the Time Warner link was sufficient to spark Zenith's stock.

Since Monday, Zenith has made a series of product announcements from a cable television trade show in New Orleans, including positive results of a test of its telco return cable modem system that makes it possible for one-way cable systems to offer cable modem services.

Analyst James Magid of Needham & Co said taken individually there were no blockbuster announements. "But the kind of statements Zenith is making appear to be backed up with marketing, manufacturing, sales and promotion programs which represent a coordinated attack on the future," Magid told Reuters.
